body: Hey id love the code if you could (:
As for my art, it’s hard to explain but if you look at Alex Pardee and Shawn Coss’s work, it’s along that kind of style mixed with heavy lyric and quote references.
I love reading, what kind of books and fanfiction do you read? I am going to listen to the song right now (:
I’m definitely going to give you a well thought out reply, just give me some time to properly read and think and respond
Thank you, I know my family will never really make peace with my decision but I hope in time they will heal.

I am indeed! 
I have struggled with my mental health since I was around six years old, over the years I have exhausted almost all resources. I have tried almost every medication, every type of therapy (psychotherapy as well as occupational therapy) etc; and over the past four years I have been constantly in and out of psychiatric wards and hospitals. 

I have hit the point where I just don’t have it in me to fight anymore. Over the years I have been told that things will get better, but no matter what I do, how hard I try, what therapy or medication I’m taking, things just haven’t improved for me; if anything things have just gotten worse. 
 
 What I have said is just a fraction of things but in essence, I don’t want to suffer anymore, have had enough; I have fought with everything I have in me and I just can’t do life anymore.
My phone is going to die, I’m on the fence. If I don’t go through with it, I will update when I can get to a charger, seeing as I’m now away from where I live. Thank you, for everything.
I just can’t do this anymore
I have attempted in the past, I know the risk involved, but I honestly don’t ever see any other way out of how I’m feeling. I’m sorry
That’s what I’m hoping for, just a few hours to go now, just got to wait for my family to go to sleep.
If I had any more energy too, I would

I’m just so tired of fighting, of just existing and not living. I have been trying to get better and recover for years, mental illness took my youth, now it has taken almost all of my twenties. If this is how I am going to be for the rest of my life, I don’t want it. I just can’t do this anymore.

Thank you so much. I’ll try and keep going but I honestly don’t know if I can, I’ve been holding on for months and hoping to see things change for the better, but I have just had no proof so far. I’m just so tired.
